class Align(Enum):
    """Align object about Axis"""

    MIN = auto()
    CENTER = auto()
    MAX = auto()
    NONE = None

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<{self.__class__.__name__}.{self.name}>"


def tuplify(obj: Any, dim: int) -> tuple | None:
    """Create a size tuple"""
    if obj is None:
        result = None
    elif isinstance(obj, (tuple, list)):
        result = tuple(obj)
    else:
        result = tuple([obj] * dim)
    return result
